_note: Found-vs-oracle LATENCY sweep: scale-free edgesPerNode=3 (mean degree ~6), UNLIMITED capacity, N=100, generous depth D=6, reliability kept IDEAL (no drops/sleeping) so success holds and this sweep isolates COST. conditions.latency is declared as a {kind:constant,value:...} object so setByPath can step conditions.latency.value; the budget (5000ms + 5000ms/round) comfortably exceeds the deepest round-trip at the largest latency, so the budget never binds.
